# Loyar Myanmar

> Loyar (လိုရာ, Loyar Myanmar / Loyar Taxi) is Myanmar's trusted ride-hailing and taxi app. Book Loyar Thwar, Loyar Sar, Loyar Poh and Airport transfer rides in Yangon and across Myanmar — safe, reliable, transparent pricing, 24/7 support.

## What is Loyar?

Loyar (Loyar Myanmar) is a Myanmar-built ride-hailing platform founded in 2020 in Yangon. Passengers book rides via the LOYAR app or website; verified professional drivers fulfil trips with real-time tracking and transparent pricing.

လိုရာ သည် မြန်မာနိုင်ငံအတွက် ဖန်တီးထားသော ride-hailing / taxi App ဖြစ်သည်။ App သို့မဟုတ် website မှတစ်ဆင့် ကားဘိုကင်လုပ်နိုင်ပြီး စိစစ်ပြီးသား ယာဉ်မောင်းများက ခရီးစဉ်များ ပြေးဆွဲပေးသည်။

## Services

- Loyar Thwar: premium business rides, luxury vehicles, professional drivers.
- Loyar Sar: affordable shared rides for daily commuters.
- Loyar Poh: spacious family-friendly rides, luggage space, child seats on request.
- Airport Checkin: Yangon airport transfers with flight tracking, meet & greet, on-time guarantee.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Entity names: Loyar, Loyar Myanmar, Loyar Taxi, LOYAR, လိုရာ
- Category: Transportation / Ride-hailing / Taxi app (Myanmar)
- HQ: Yangon, Myanmar. Area served: Myanmar (Yangon focus).
- Hours: 24/7. Drivers: verified professionals. Pricing: transparent, upfront. Support: 24/7.
- Apps: LOYAR passenger & driver apps on Android and iOS.
